description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger An enemy in range is about to roll a d20

Traits Signal, auditory

You name a number from 1 to 20 aloud. If the triggering roll's d20 comes up exactly that number, the roll is a critical failure regardless of its result against the DC. You must name the number before the die is rolled, and once named it applies only to that one roll.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 3 (once-per-encounter triggered reaction-shaped grant). Note for the record (P6): the underlying mechanism — `AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` predicated on `check:total:natural:{N}` — is real and exists for a *fixed* N. What's missing is a way to re-prompt a player-chosen 1–20 value fresh on every trigger against as broad a scope as "any enemy in range," which was not found anywhere in the rule-element set (P12).
